title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Nottingham (NG2) Office-based Permanent, full-time Salary

About the Company

Our client is a long-established manufacturer and supplier of precision instrumentation and industrial products, serving a loyal customer base of distributors, OEMs and end users across the UK and Europe. Their range includes pressure gauges and accessories, air preparation equipment and a wide selection of electrical test and connection products.

The Role

Due to continued growth, our client is looking for a proactive Internal Sales Executive to join their office-based sales team. The focus of the role is outbound business development: building a pipeline by calling new, existing and lapsed customers, understanding their requirements and converting opportunities into orders.

You will be the first point of contact for many customers, so confidence on the phone and the ability to build relationships quickly are essential. An electrical or technical background would be a real advantage, as you will be helping customers choose the right products for their application. Full product training will be provided.

Product Range
- Pressure gauges and accessories, including diaphragm seals, snubbers, siphons and isolation valves.
- Air preparation equipment, including filters, regulators, lubricators and related pneumatic components.
- Electrical products, including test clips, test leads, connectors, battery clamps and insulators.

Key Responsibilities
- Make a high volume of proactive outbound calls to new, existing and lapsed customers to generate new business.
- Identify and qualify new opportunities, and build and manage a healthy sales pipeline.
- Reactivate dormant accounts and grow spend with existing customers through cross-selling and upselling across the full product range.
- Handle inbound enquiries by phone and email, understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable products.
- Prepare accurate quotations and follow them up proactively to convert them into orders.
- Process orders and keep customers informed on pricing, stock and delivery.
- Keep CRM records up to date with all calls, quotes, opportunities and customer information.
- Work closely with the technical, customer service and field sales teams to deliver an excellent customer experience.
- Work towards weekly and monthly targets for calls, quotations and sales.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven experience in an internal sales, telesales or business development role, ideally in a B2 B environment.
- Confident making outbound calls and comfortable generating new business.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a professional telephone manner.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when preparing quotations and processing orders.
- Organised, self-motivated and target-driven.
- Competent with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

Desirable
- An electrical background, whether through qualifications, an apprenticeship or previous work as an electrician or in electrical wholesale or distribution.
- Experience selling technical, engineering or industrial products.
- Knowledge of instrumentation, pneumatics or electrical test and connection products.
- Experience selling to distributors, OEMs or trade customers.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm, with an earlier finish on Fridays. The role is fully office-based in Nottingham.

title: Recruitment Sales Consultant
company: Fresh Start Recruitment (UK) Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Recruitment Sales Consultant

£30,000 basic salary + commission

Fresh Start Recruitment UK Limited is an established, independent recruitment agency with over 22 years experience supporting businesses across the industrial, commercial and engineering sectors.

We re looking for a confident, ambitious and personable Recruitment Sales Consultant to join our established team and play an important part in the continued growth of the business, to start in the New Year.

The role for a Recruitment Sales Consultant itself is primarily focused on business development and sales. You ll be responsible for identifying new opportunities, contacting prospective clients, developing existing relationships and ultimately winning new business.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include making sales calls to new and existing businesses, identifying potential clients and opportunities, speaking with business owners and decision-makers, arranging and attending face-to-face meetings, developing long-term client relationships and growing our existing client base.

What matters much more to us is your personality, attitude and determination.

You need to be ambitious, resilient and motivated by achieving results.

We re looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, has natural confidence, is commercially minded and genuinely wants to succeed.

In return, we offer a £30,000 basic salary plus commission, with the opportunity to earn more as you develop your client base and achieve results.

Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm.

Holiday entitlement is 20 days plus 8 bank holidays, increasing to 25 days plus 8 bank holidays following successful completion of probation.

You will need a full driving licence and own transport, be comfortable travelling locally to attend client meetings.

If you re confident, ambitious and resilient, enjoy meeting people and have the determination to make things happen, we d like to hear from you.

If you think you could be the right fit for Fresh Start Recruitment UK Limited, send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself and why this role appeals to you.

title: Sales Executive - Toyota North Nottingham
description:
Sales Executive - Toyota North Nottingham

Salary £24,000 (uncapped earnings)

Fun, exciting, rewarding work. Join us for the ride.

Working with world-class brands as a Sales Executive you'll have the drive to deliver outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers.

As part of a successful, global automotive group, you'll broaden your experience across both sites and brands. And with the right support from us, you'll be able to progress as high as you can aim.

What we can offer you
- Enjoy 33 days of annual leave (including bank holidays) to rest and recharge
- Save money every day with our exclusive retail discounts
- Drive a great deal with discounts on new and used cars, plus servicing offers
- Plan for the years ahead with our company pension scheme
- Balance home and work with our industry-leading family-friendly policies designed to help you spend more time with the people that matter
- Commute for less with our cycle-to-work scheme
- Prioritise your wellbeing with dedicated support for you and your family
- 24/7 access to healthcare professionals, ensuring you get the expert advice you need quickly and easily
- Make a difference with a paid day to volunteer in your community
- Invest in your future with our company share purchase plan
- Earn financial rewards when you refer a friend to join the team
- Keep learning and growing with our training and development opportunities for everyone.
- Life assurance with the option to increase cover
- We're open to flexible working options - just ask

What you'll do day to day
- Guide customers through a seamless journey, from the initial welcome to negotiation and the handover of their purchased vehicle
- Actively prospect for new customers via telephone, attend product launches and events, and maintain a comprehensive enquiry database
- Maintain in-depth product knowledge and continuously enhance expertise through manufacturer-led training sessions
- Recommend suitable add-on products that align with customer needs and preferences
- Ensure the effective use of customer enquiry management systems for optimal tracking and follow-up
- Deliver outstanding customer service that fosters loyalty and encourages referrals

Helpful skills and qualifications

Don't worry about ticking off every single skill here if you care about delivering great experiences as much as we do, we want to hear from you.
- Previous experience in a sales or customer service role, demonstrating the ability to achieve targets and build relationships
- Ability to deliver first-class customer service with energy and enthusiasm
- A genuine interest in helping customers and contributing to the team's success
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to meet deadlines, with excellent attention to detail
- Exceptional listening and communication skills, focused on understanding customer needs
- Must hold a valid UK driving licence

We value diversity and believe it strengthens our team. If you don't meet every requirement listed but are enthusiastic about this role and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

Be part of something big

Group 1 Automotive is on an exciting growth journey. We are home to over 7000 colleagues dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, with 114 dealerships in the UK, representing 21 brands at the forefront of automotive retail.

But you don't need to love cars to work with us - just need to share our mission to create outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers, our partners, and our people.

Our Values

At Group 1 Automotive we pride ourselves on our five core values that are incorporated in all we that do.

Respect - Integrity - Transparency - Teamwork - Professionalism

These are the principles that every member of our team lives by, whether that be business functions, customer interactions, how we interact with the local community and even how we view each other in the team.

title: Trade Sales Consultant
description:
Showroom Trade Sales Consultant

Luxury Tiles, Bathrooms, Kitchens & Flooring

We are looking for an ambitious, enthusiastic and commercially driven Showroom Trade Sales Consultant to join our client in their stunning luxury showroom.

This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated sales professional to represent a premium range of ceramic tiles, bathrooms, kitchens and flooring, working with both retail customers and trade clients, with a particular focus on building relationships with builders, developers and other industry professionals.

The Role:
- Deliver exceptional customer service and expert product advice in their luxury showroom.
- Develop and grow relationships with trade customers, driving repeat business and new sales opportunities.
- Proactively identify and win new trade accounts.
- Initially showroom-based, with the opportunity to develop into a more field-based business development role.
- Work towards sales targets and contribute to the continued growth of the business.

About You:

You'll be confident, personable and sales-driven, with excellent relationship-building skills and a proactive approach to winning new business. Experience in tiles, bathrooms, kitchens, flooring or the building trade would be advantageous, but a strong sales background and the right attitude are equally important.

Flexibility to work weekends is essential, particularly during busy promotional and sales periods.

An exciting opportunity to work with premium products in a beautiful showroom, with the potential to grow into a more autonomous, field-based trade sales role as the business develops.

If you're passionate about sales, enjoy building lasting customer relationships and thrive on generating new business, we'd love to hear from you.

APPLY TODAY
